e.title: 中国险企春招 AI 人才
e.summary: 中国险企春季招聘：AI 和医疗健康类人才需求增长
e.body:
中国险企春季招聘报道（经济日报）：AI 和医疗健康类人才需求增长——内地保险招聘的结构性信号。对 RIAA：中国保险招聘的人才需求信号——AI/医疗健康人才需求上升（与 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]] 亚洲市场对照）；配合 [[nfra-statistics]]（中国数据）、[[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]]（AI 监管）理解内地市场；内地求职（[[rim534]] 语境）的技能方向参考；「AI 人才需求增长」的内地实证。

e.title_hk: 中國險企春招 AI 人才
e.summary_en: Chinese insurers' spring recruitment: growing demand for AI and healthcare talent
e.summary_hk: 中國險企春季招聘：AI 和醫療健康類人才需求增長
e.body_en:
A report of Chinese insurers' spring recruitment (Economic Daily): growing demand for AI and healthcare talent — a structural signal of mainland insurance hiring. For RIAA: a talent-demand signal of Chinese insurance hiring — rising AI/healthcare demand (contrasting the Asian market of [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]); with [[nfra-statistics]] (China data) and [[nfra-ai-guiding-opinions]] (AI regulation) frame the mainland market; a skill-direction reference for mainland jobs (the [[rim534]] context); mainland evidence of 'growing AI-talent demand'.
